blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine men’s modern pentathlon team missed the podium despite Samuel German’s strong start in the individual final round in the Asian Games 2026 on Sunday at Anjo Sports Park. German placed second in fencing with 244 points before topping the obstacle event with the fastest time of 19.51 seconds for 387 points. But German placed 18th in swimming with 246 points and 16th in laser run with 608 points, settling for 15th overall with 1,485 points. “It was exciting because I faced the strongest competitors.
